drafted_from: tool:google-account-read_mail_thread's own row in tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (invoke method, url, body_template, input and output schema); Gmail response values worked out from that row for the synthetic input
start_here: Say to your AI: "List the messages of conversation 18c1a2b3d4e5f601 in order. Use my Google account connection service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery." It runs tool:google-account-read_mail_thread as that account and hands back the Gmail answer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it calls Gmail for one Google account the connection names and answers what Gmail returns.
instructions: 1. Connect a Google account in your Workshop connections and note its handle, like service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery.

2. Say to your AI: "List the messages of conversation 18c1a2b3d4e5f601 in order." and let it call run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:google-account-read_mail_thread, and the input {"connection":{"connection_id":"service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery"},"thread_id":"18c1a2b3d4e5f601"}.

3. Read what comes back: the request goes as GET  the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/threads/18c1a2b3d4e5f601?format=metadata with the headers From, To, Cc, Subject, Date and Message-ID.
4. Read one message in full with tool:google-account-read_a_mail.

worked_examples.title: Read the message list of one Gmail conversation on a sample input
worked_examples.ask: List the messages of conversation 18c1a2b3d4e5f601 in order.
worked_examples.given: read from tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (its invoke url, method and body_template) and checked against tools/read-and-write-gmail/test/rows.test.mjs. A conversation with two messages, one from Sam and one reply from Alex. The call it makes: GET the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/threads/18c1a2b3d4e5f601?format=metadata with the headers From, To, Cc, Subject, Date and Message-ID.
worked_examples.hands_back: Gmail answers id "18c1a2b3d4e5f601" and messages: [{"id":"18c1a2b3d4e5f601","labelIds":["SENT"],"snippet":"Your bakery order is ready at 3 PM.","internalDate":"1794686400000"},{"id":"18c1a2b3d4e5f888","labelIds":["INBOX","UNREAD"],"snippet":"Thanks, I will be there."}], each with its From, To, Subject, Date and Message-ID headers. No message words come back.
